Hi Mina —

Thanks for the context and the attachment. High level from the AWS Marketplace side:
1) Mandatory items for SaaS/AMIs:
   - SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) OR customer-facing security questionnaire answers (we can accept a SOC2 in progress but it slows approval)
   - Packaging artifact (SaaS: redirect/config + entitlement integration; AMI/Container: image + test harness)
   - Technical test plan + verification user with limited access for AWS validation team
2) Optional but recommended:
   - Pen test summary / vulnerability scan report
   - Third-party performance benchmarks for common workloads
3) Co-sell enablement: joint solution brief and a short partner training deck (15–20 slides) are typical to get included in seller enablement rotations.
4) Timeline: once artifacts are in, tech validation typically 7–10 business days for SaaS, 10–15 for AMIs/containers depending on queue.

I'll attach our partner checklist and add a few notes inline in your readiness doc. For the call, we have slots Tue 12/1 09:00-11:00 PT or Wed 12/2 14:00-16:00 PT. Which works best?

[Attachment: aws_marketplace_checklist.docx (DOCX)]

Best,
